text:
maria_sales: Heads-up: medtech prospect needs a 2-week pilot with traffic strictly confined to Canada + Brazil. Requirements: 95th percentile <200ms, and a complete list of any subprocessors that would touch data. Procurement wants a ballpark cost and timeline today.

igor_presales: Quick clarifier 1 do they need both countries live at day 0 or can we phase (Canada first)? Phasing could cut costs.

maria_sales: They prefer both, but will consider Canada-first if the delta is big. Also they flagged "no copies outside country" in their security questionnaire.

samir_sre: For latency: ca-central1 hosted can hit that. sa-east1 hosted capacity is limited; edge nodes might help latency but cannot satisfy strict "no copies" because of multi-tenant backups/metrics. For literal "no copies" we need Dedicated per country or Private.

anya_security: Important: medtech = potential PHI. BYOK helps protect keys but does NOT prevent metadata/replication or internal logs from leaving country. If the Q states "no copies outside country", hosted multi-tenant is not adequate. Options: 1) short-term Dedicated per country (we pin tenants + disable cross-region replication), or 2) Private (VPC/on-prem).

ops_ashley: I can inventory quotas and give a provisional reserved price. Need model size, average seq, and peak window details. Also confirm whether monitoring/alerting is allowed to call centralized endpoints.

maria_sales: Model is ~7B, avg seq 512, peak windows nightly: ~30 minutes at ~40 qps, baseline ~3-5 qps. Monitoring can be in-country only if Dedicated.

igor_presales: Tech tradeoff note for customer: Hosted = fastest + cheapest but cannot meet absolute residency. Dedicated/Private = meets residency but 48-72h provisioning and higher cost. I'll draft a 1-paragraph summary.

samir_sre: Rough back-of-envelope: a 2x A10G-equivalent dedicated pool for 14 days (including provisioning overhead) ~ $11k-$16k/region. Hosted per-token compute for expected volume is lower but doesn't meet the "no copies" constraint. Ops to confirm exact numbers.

noah_legal: If they insist on contract language about "no copies outside country" we need to review subprocessor listing and potentially add carve-outs. Security to publish subproc list first; legal will then advise.

anya_security: I'll produce a minimal subprocessor manifest for both hosted and dedicated. Hosted list will include CSP, logging vendor, metrics backend, and KMS provider; Dedicated shrinks that list. I'll also attach PHI checklist and SOC2 pointers. If they want local datacenter auditor contacts for Brazil we'll link to CSP public compliance docs; nonpublic attestations require legal approval.

maria_sales: Good. Tell me what to say to keep momentum?

ops_ashley: Tell them: (1) we can propose a short-term Dedicated in Canada + Brazil to satisfy residency (2) timeline: quota check today, price estimate tomorrow AM, provisioning ~48-72h after PO + approvals, (3) blockers: legal review of subproc list and budget approval.

igor_presales: Small sample routing snippet for Dedicated (to share with their SOC): ```json
{"routing_policy":"geo-fence","allowed_countries":["CA","BR"],"replication":"disabled","monitoring_eu_endpoint":"false"}```

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll share that and the rough ballpark and ask if Canada-only is acceptable as an interim step. Will update once ops/security post docs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
